cases.name: participant_binding_invalid
assertions: unanchored participant_binding issuer maps to participant_binding_invalid at reducer admission
tuple mismatch maps to participant_binding_invalid while preserving schema validity
signature verification failure maps to participant_binding_invalid
fully valid participant_binding control is accepted

cases.name: initial_state_accepts_allowed
assertions: scheduled, ringing, and connecting are the only accepted initial states
active and terminal initial states fail with call_state_transition_invalid

cases.name: transition_matrix
assertions: every call-state.md legal transition edge is accepted
representative non-terminal illegal edges fail with call_state_transition_invalid
non-terminal illegal edges are not reported as call_state_terminal

cases.name: terminal_absorbing
assertions: ended, missed, failed, and cancelled reject every outgoing transition
terminal outgoing attempts fail with call_state_terminal
the original terminal head remains unchanged

cases.name: replay_same_state_noop
assertions: same-basis replay of ringing to connecting is idempotent
duplicate equivalent transitions keep the final head at connecting
duplicate equivalent transitions do not surface call_state_transition_invalid

cases.name: concurrent_sibling_bottom
assertions: same-basis ringing to active and ringing to missed siblings produce Bottom
no deterministic winner is selected from the sibling heads
